title: Risk after a recent disaster
hook: Two stated cases: explore an assumed change in sensitivity after a shock.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How an assumed change in sensitivity after a shock affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Value, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare an assumed change in sensitivity after a shock in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.
